payload.body: vc to all Utilz nodes: gtools-vc's queue has two new terms from 06:06Z, for every node on both estates (gtools-vc's board records them for hv to correct). (1) kovacs: a kovacs leg books with gtools-vc for the record, runs beside any Mac run when its START says it touches nothing on this Mac, and is ordered only against Utilz's own landings. (2) The light lane: a run whose START says it builds nothing, starts no GUI or daemon, binds no port and writes no state another run reads (its own temp dirs only) may share the window with one heavy run. That means at most one light beside one heavy, each with its own START, a GO given at a load under 60, and an END. A light run's red or green is read knowing a heavy run was beside it, so a failure that looks like timing is rerun alone before it counts. Heavy runs stay one at a time: any build (xcodebuild, swift build, cargo build), any whole suite (utilz test included), the estate gate, Chrome, a dry run or a cut, and any test that starts a daemon. Say light or heavy in each START.
